errors.text: The proposed SRO dissolution and amorphous shear-banding mechanism is not established by the supplied evidence or by the target simulation results.

An increased HCP atom count is treated as evidence of amorphization, although HCP classification in an FCC alloy primarily identifies stacking-fault or locally HCP-like environments; genuine amorphization would generally increase atoms classified as disordered or 'other.'

The pre-anneal control does not cleanly separate thermal softening from mechanical annealing because it is subsequently indented under the same high-temperature conditions, and the stated falsification rule conflates static thermal relaxation with deformation-induced disorder.
